planItem: 77.44.7.A — content.href invalid Save/Publish gate on every registered element type
finding: content.href is registered for both button and link. A previous real-browser check exercised invalid URL feedback and request blocking only on button, leaving the second applicable authored element type without the same negative lifecycle assertion.
testChange: tests/browser/editor-inspector-lifecycle.test.js creates an independent valid unsaved text change for each applicable type so Publish is enabled, then enters javascript:alert(1) in its registered content.href control. For both button and link, it asserts Save and Publish issue no API request and preserve the server draft and public snapshot. It also verifies the invalid button value remains editable, then retains the existing corrected-href Undo/Redo, Save/reload, separate Publish and public renderer assertions for both types.
iterations: A default sandbox run was blocked at loopback listen with EPERM; the unchanged test was run with local network permission.
The fixture makes a valid unsaved text edit before each invalid URL attempt so the Publish action is enabled and its validation guard is actually exercised.
